description:
Render several bookmarks or poses into one labelled grid with real lighting, and compare each bookmark with its last render (difference map). The quick look at every hero view after a change.
Guide: summer_docs_read {"id":"tool/shot-sheet"}

aspect.description: Frame width/height (default 1.7778 = 16:9). Every tile uses it.

compare_previous.description: For bookmark shots: one row per bookmark of [previous render | now | difference map], with the share of changed pixels in the caption.

max_size.description: Longest edge of the returned JPEG in pixels (default 1536). Bigger costs more context; up to 4096 for detail work on a PC.

save_to.description: Also write the returned image to res://.summer/shots/saved/<name>.jpg (1-64 of A-Z a-z 0-9 _ -; needs max_size <= 1024).

scenePath.description: Scene to look at, e.g. "res://levels/town.tscn" (the SAVED file). Omit for the scene open in the editor.

shots.description: 1-12 shots, each a bookmark_name OR camera_position + camera_look_at (+ fov), with an optional label. Rendered in this order, left to right, top to bottom.

bookmark_name.description: Pose from a camera bookmark (summer_engine_save_camera_bookmark (list: summer_engine_list_camera_bookmarks)). Use INSTEAD of camera_position/camera_look_at.

camera_look_at.description: Explicit pose: point the camera looks at, "Vector3(x, y, z)".

camera_position.description: Explicit pose: camera position, "Vector3(x, y, z)". Goes with camera_look_at.

fov.description: Vertical field of view in degrees (1..179). Default: the bookmark's own, or 60.

label.description: Tile label (1-64 printable characters, no quotes, backslashes or $). Default: the bookmark name or 'shot N'.

update_previous.description: Replace each bookmark's previous image (its compare baseline) with this render without comparing.

view.description: "beauty" (default: real environment, lights, fog, tonemap), "lighting" (light only), "unshaded" (albedo/texture only), "normals" (world normals, x red y green z blue), "overdraw", "wireframe".

name: summer_shot_sheet
title: Render a sheet of views
